title: Seasonal OKRs -> Engineering Commitment Slate: Q3 Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Jordan Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Quarterly Roadmap
description:
Purpose: Translate seasonal OKRs into a concrete engineering commitment slate that balances throughput, model health, and cost for the Hosted API + Model Catalog in Q3. This ticket synthesizes cross-functional tradeoffs and produces a prioritized set of deliverables, acceptance criteria, and staggered rollout windows so Eng can commit capacity and PM/Design can schedule experiments.

Overview:
- Goal: Align OKRs (reduce median inference latency by 10%, decrease per-token cost by 12%, and maintain model quality/regression <= 1% on sentinel prompts) with a set of engineering commitments and rollout phases.
- Scope: Hosted API performance knobs, canary rollout plan for model swaps, model health/alerting updates, cost-optimization experiments (quantization/auto-batching), and developer-facing release notes for customers.
- Non-goals: Deep kernel development or hardware procurement (captured in separate ENG epics).
acceptance_criteria: Runbook: A one-page runbook that ties each OKR to a measurable metric and owner (PM/Eng/Design).
Commitments: Eng agrees to three measurable commitments with target dates and SLO delta budgets (latency, cost, availability).
Canary Plan: Canary cohort configuration defined (1%, 5%, 20%) with automated rollback thresholds tied to error rate and latency regressions.
Model Health: Eval suite (50 sentinel prompts) integrated to CI so regression alerts fire within 30 minutes of a rollout breach.
Customer Communication: Drafted customer-facing changelog and opt-out guidance for sensitive customers on Private/Dedicated tiers.
milestones: Week 1 (2026-03-16): Draft commitment slate + metric mapping; stakeholder sync with Eng, Design, SRE.
Week 2 (2026-03-23): Finalize canary and rollback thresholds; surface required infra changes to ENG backlog.
Week 4 (2026-04-06): Eval CI integration and golden prompt set validated; dry-run canary in staging.
Week 8 (2026-05-04): Production pilot (1% cohort) for prioritized model swap + batching config.
Week 12 (2026-06-01): Expand pilot to 20% or roll back per thresholds; finalize postmortem and deck for exec review.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Canary triggers due to traffic pattern mismatch. Mitigation: Add traffic fingerprinting and a staging shadow run for two days before production canary.
Risk: Cost savings reduce quality. Mitigation: Define minimum quality floor and a 'cost-vs-quality' decision gate requiring PM+Eng approval before expansion.
Risk: Infra blockers (autoscaler tuning). Mitigation: Reserve a 4-day engineering buffer in week 3 and escalate to Dedicated capacity team if needed.
communication_plan: Weekly stakeholder sync (30m) with action tracker.
Bi-weekly status updates on #pm-hostedapi and brief summary to execs at week 6.
Post-release: one-pager and customer FAQ published to Help Center.
